lokele: Imi Paulo, Botomomu wa Masiya Yesu ko la lisangi lia Mungu, ende ebüchomu ebale nda Efeso la ende ebasokokomɛlɛ ndoimela Masiya Yesu,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ 1:1 Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

lokele: booto end’ino la lilatemi lia Mungu Sango wasu la elia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Mungu la Sango wa Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya, ainelomoko la loomalo, ako Inde oyasofotes’iso la loomalo lototina la bafaefi ba bolimo oyale nda Use, ko l’eoka ya Masiya,
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

lokele: imɔ kwa aaka Inde iso ko l’eoka ya Masiya oso wa bakɔkɔmɛlɛɛlɔ ba wenda bototina, mbo iso toyaleke ebüchomu l’ebatiɛnɛlɛ la batwanelo nda baiso bande.
english: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

lokele: Ko la losamɔ, Mungu nd’asangaka ko kwala ndotang’iso bana bande angɛnɛ ko l’eoka ya Yesu Masiya;
english: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

lokele: ko l’eoka ya loomalo loa lisangi liande mbo booto wande wa likama ewafaefak’Inde iso lifaefela eoka ya Inde Oyasamomu la lɔkɛmɔ;
english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

lokele: la ko la liwatemi lande tosoendolomo eoka ya bakila bande, tosomɛsɛlɔmɔ batwanelo basu kwa engani nde la lilya lia booto wande,
english: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

lokele: ebosowɛl’Inde end’iso.
english: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

lokele: Asoluwes’iso lisangi liande ko la wɛlï la liluwani fafo liande, liko lisangi liande elisoisokoelomo iso kwa asɔɛn’Inde bolau nda kuko ya Masiya,
english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

lokele: liko likɔmɔnyi lia wenda bototina eyakenganeke lisho, mbo bitotina ebile nda Use, la ono se biwatemeke ndolitesa Ɔmwito kongo ako Masiya.
english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

lokele: Ko l’eoka yande tosoɔla imɔ likaɔ ko lande oyasosɛl’iso kwala, kwa asangak’Inde oyatokomya bitotina ko la lisangi liande angɛnɛ,
english: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

lokele: litina mbo toomaleseke tala yande, iso ebalendeloko Masiya oso.
english: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

lokele: Ino imɔ ebasowatema la Masiya, ebasoka inango shande sha wewe, siko Mboli Ilau ya liuwesi lianu, ino osolendelo ko Inde la watomoko chapa yande eko Bolimo Botanu ewatikomoko ino lisakä.
english: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

lokele: Bolimo ale tukä ya loendolomo loasu, tukä eyefomu iso konda eyekaɔlɛk’iso loao wewe, mbo tala ya lina liande einelomoko.
english: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

lokele: Eokao, imi angɛnɛ to oyasoka mboli ya lilendelu lianu ndolendelo Ngɛnɛ Yesu la losamɔ loanu ndosamaka ebüchomu batotina,
english: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

lokele: itimache ndofaka Mungu kelekele eoka yanu la ndosingwaka baina banu nda basomboli bami,
english: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

lokele: mbo Mungu wa Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya, Sango wa tala, afek’ino bolimo wa wɛlï la ewoisola litina lia njasɔ yande;
english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

lokele: la imɔ ko mbo aaneseke baiso ba betema yanu swaa mbo ino oluweke kwa ayali iɛli esiafomoko ino ani atomoko ino lioi la kwa ayali imɔ lilya lia tala-ye eyesosangol’ino ebüchelomu Masiya,
english: having the eyes of your hearts 1:18 enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

lokele: la mbo oluweke likama lia bofoka wande ewoeta ebole lasu ebasoimel’Inde, bofoka ona ebole la isosha la itinjo shofumbes’iso;
english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

lokele: bofoka-bo wande ewayalaka lande ani atɛmɔlɔkɔ Masiya nda liwa, l’ani ayalesak’Inde se nda osamba wande wa olome nda Use,
english: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

lokele: omao likolo lia kanda bitotina ya likomyi la isosha la bofoka la likakalesi la likolo lia baina batotina ebatosingwakomo, inga to nda mbile-ye kongo, kangä imɔ nda mbile eyekayeke.
english: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

lokele: Ongoma Mungu asɛlɛkɛ yaatotina ose ya batindi bande la afak’Inde isosha shoyala Botö wa njasɔ bitotina ya Etanda;
english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

lokele: Etanda yende Bindo yande, yende lɔɔlwɔ loande oyatɔɔlɔlɔ yaatotina hɔlɔɔ.
english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

lokele: La ino imɔ osofomo liwawi liyai, ino ebawaka oso nda batwanelo la nda batongwi banu,
english: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

lokele: ani akɛndɛkɛndɛk’ino ndotutaka Bɔkɔta wa isosha sha bofolalu, Bolimo Obe oyatofumbaka ko kwani sisi ya bana ba totefola.
english: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.

lokele: La iso batotina imɔ twakɛndɛkɛ sisi ya bato ba bɔfɔnɔ-bo nda yɛmɛ ya bindo la twalitesaka ko yao eyalɛmbɛkɛ bindo la baenyeli angɛnɛ, la ongoma twayalaka balomboki ebenganaka la efango ya Mungu kwa ebamɔi batotina.
english: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

lokele: Nde Mungu ko l’eoka ya booto wike ebosofota lande la eoka ya losamɔ lofi elososamak’Inde osam’iso,
english: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

lokele: eyayaelak’iso ko belyo nda batongwi basu, Inde lof’iso liwawi liyai ko la Masiya angɛnɛ, (osouwesomo ngo ko la booto)
english: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

lokele: la atɛmɔlɔkɔ iso la asoyales’iso se nda Use amamwito lande ko la liwatemi la Masiya Yesu,
english: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

lokele: Mungu lokela ongoma mbo, nda mbile ebilayeke, lilya lia likama lia booto wande liɛnɛkɛlɛkɛ fololo, boko booto wande end’iso ebawatemi la Masiya Yesu.
english: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

lokele: Eoka osouwesomo ngo ko la booto ko l’eoka ya lilendelu la liuwesi-li liti l’eoka yanu, lile ngo ko lifaefi lia Mungu angɛnɛ;
english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

lokele: inga l’eoka ya yao ebisokelak’ino, mbo boto angɔmɔi atafaala l’iomala.
english: not of works, that no one would boast.

lokele: Eoka iso twende likeli liande, iso ebasotonjomo liasi ani asowatema iso la Masiya Yesu mbo tokelakeke ko yao ebisotatonja Mungu oso mbo tokɛndɛlɛkɛ ngo ko ndayao. BaYuda l’ebati BaYuda, batotina fɛɛ basootwana ko la Yesu
english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

lokele: Eokao enyelaka to mbo ino ebayalaka koso ba tukela ya wenda-bo, nda loasɔ loa lokomba ebatangomu nde mbo Eba sunga ko la bato ebatangomu Eba totombe, loasɔ loa lokomba ko la besamba ya bato,
english: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),

lokele: enyelaka to mbo nda mbile ena wasiamaka la Masiya, otiayalaka eba tukela ya Isalaele la bɛɛnda nda loasɔ loa ngɛla ya basakä ba Mungu, l’angwɛnɛ iɛli sha liuwesi, angwɛnɛ Mungu nda wenda-bo.
english: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

lokele: Nde kwani ko l’eoka ya Masiya Yesu, ino ebasiamaka esika, ososishanesomo tinatina ko la bakila ba Masiya.
english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

lokele: Eoka Inde angɛnɛ ende lilatemi liasu, asosanganes’iso ba tukela imbale ko bofindi ɔmwito la asowɛlɛ likula elisosɛnyanes’iso se,
english: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

lokele: ani ko nda bindo yande angɛnɛ asoola liiyani liko Bikela ya ndola la bakakanelo, ko la litina mbo akindoleke yaambale ko boto ɔmwito oyai; ongoma to lilatemi;
english: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,

lokele: la mbo aotwaneseke yaambale nda bindo ɛmwito ende Mungu ko la liwa liande nda lieka, ongoma asotungesa liiyani ko la liao.
english: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.

lokele: Limɔ Inde loya oyanangoel’ino Mboli Ilau ya liɔngɛsi lia njasɔ yanu, bako ino ebasiyamaka esika, la end’iso imɔ ebayalaka tina la Mungu;
english: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

lokele: eoka ko lande ako Masiya, iso lanu yaambale tosɔɔlɔ isosha shɔɔtɔ ende Mungu Sango ko la Bolimo Ɔmwito.
english: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

lokele: Eokao, ino ot’imɔ bɛɛnda la ebasolimela nda yese yasi, nde osoya oko toote twa yese ya ebüchomu ba Mungu l’eba bɔkɔ̈kɔ wande angɛnɛ.
english: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,

lokele: Ino ososwomo nda lionda lia Batomomu la Batɔndɔli, ani Masiya Yesu angɛnɛ ale litalɛ lia ikululu sha ndakɔ etotina;
english: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

lokele: ndakɔ etotina esoundakana ndokɔkɔmɔ ko lande ako Yesu la etokondakana ko ndoiyela esemoelo eyüchomu ende Ngɛnɛ.
english: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

lokele: Ongoma, ino imɔ ososwomo amamwito ndoyala eyaelo ya Mungu ko la Bolimo wande.
english: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

lokele: Ko la litina-li to, imi Paulo, boto wa Masiya oyakandomu bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, eoka yanu ba tukela yasi,
english: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

lokele: eluwa nde osoka mbo isosha sha likuwa-li lifomu ende’mi ko la booto wa Mungu,
english: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

lokele: la imɔ mbo Mungu angɛnɛ nd’aisoelaka’mi njasɔ yande ebiaisomoko oso, kwa asɔnɛli’mi ino oso ko la baoi bamyɔ kongo;
english: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

lokele: akatangek’ino bao, ino kokɔkɔlɔ olembeela liluwani liami lioluwa njasɔ ya mbiso ya Masiya,
english: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

lokele: ebitialuwesomoko ende bato ba fɛtɔ ya oso, kwa asɔɛnɛsɔmɔ nde yao fololo ende Batomomu la Batɔndɔli ebüchomu ko la Bolimo.
english: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

lokele: Ebisoɛnɛsɔmɔ biko mbo bato ba biese yasi bende imɔ l’isosha shosangola botiko ko ɔmɔi la mbo bende ba bofindi ko ɔmɔi, la batofomo imɔ ko lisakä lia liuwesi lia liwatemi la Masiya Yesu ko l’eoka ya Mboli Ilau,
english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

lokele: Yafomoko isosha shosungaka nda likuwa-li ko la lifi lia booto wa Mungu eliafomoko’mi ko la lifumbesi lia bofoka wande.
english: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

lokele: Booto-bo wafomoko ende’mi, ambo imi oyatiangoengana la itungangɔlɔ sha ebüchomu batotina ba Masiya, mbo inangokoeleke bato ba wenda-bo Mboli Ilau ya bondanda wa Masiya ebotiango woluwana loketi,
english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

lokele: mbo yɛnɛsɛkɛ bato batotina litina lia yao eyaisomoko ko la fɛtɔ ya oso nda botema wa Mungu oyakelaka bitotina;
english: and to make all men see what is the administration 3:9 of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

lokele: mbo wɛlï wa Mungu ebole la bɛfɔnɔ wikewike boluwesomoko ende bekomyi l’eba tososha nda Use ko la Etanda,
english: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

lokele: kwa asangaka ngo ko Inde kwalakwala la kwa asokoch’Inde kwanikwani ko la Masiya Yesu Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

lokele: Twende la isosha shotendela ndoonga lande la ndosishana lande ko la lilendelu ndolendelo Inde ako Masiya.
english: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

lokele: Eokao isolɔmbɔkɔlɔ mbo totawa esole eoka ya bifembi ebitokaka’mi loasɔ loanu, eoka yao bile ko liomala lianu.
english: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

lokele: Ko la litina-li to, isoswa balui se oso wa Sango,
english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

lokele: oyasosingwomo lina-li lia Sango nda befindi bitotina, la nda Use la ono se,
english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

lokele: isosombola mbo, kwa ayal’Inde angɛnɛ la bondanda wa liomala la tala, awangemeseke ino la Bolimo wande, atiteni yanu,
english: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

lokele: la mbo Masiya ayalakeke nda betema yanu ko la lilendelu, mbo okokomɛkɛ la ɔɔ̈tɛkɛ nda losamɔ kwa isandu nda nyɛlɛ,
english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

lokele: la mbo okɔkɔlɛkɛ ndoluwa, amamwito la batotina ebüchomu ba Masiya, ikweelo sha losamɔ loande, siko bofalu la bosa, la bolundu la botalemu,
english: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

lokele: ndoluwa losamɔ loa Masiya eloti loluwomo la wɛli wasu; mbo otumesomoko fuu ko la lotumeso loa Mungu.
english: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

lokele: Mungu oyasokɔkɔlɔ ndokela yao ebisoetela basomboli la baenyeli basu,
english: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

lokele: ko la bofoka eboyali nd’atiteni yasu, Inde afomoko tala la isosha sha Etanda la esha Masiya Yesu ko layalaya. Ongoma.
english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

lokele: Eokao, imi Paulo, oyakandomu bɔnyɔlɔlɔ eoka ya likuwa lia Ngɛnɛ, isolɔmbɔkɔl’ino ndokɛndɛkɛndɛ la boyaeli wengani l’ebatomu lioi ndotutak’Inde,
english: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

lokele: la liikami se la botema sambo la limɛsɛkɛlɛni la lisambolani ko la losamɔ,
english: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

lokele: fumbaka la bofiili wokuliana kwa boto ɔmwito nda liwatemani lia lilatemi ko la Bolimo.
english: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

lokele: Bindo yende ngo ko ɛmwito la Bolimo ngo ko Ɔmwito, kwa ani atomoko ino lioi la iɛli ko simɔi,
english: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

lokele: ko Ngɛnɛ Ɔmwito, lilendelu limɔi, lilufi ko limɔi,
english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

lokele: ko Mungu ɔmɔi ako Sango wa yaatotina, oyale likolo lia yaatotina, oyasuchi yaatotina, la oyale atiteni ya batotina.
english: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

lokele: Nde booto wa Mungu bofomu nd’iso oto la oto ko la likao lia lifaefi lia Masiya.
english: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

lokele: Nda loasɔ-lo Lokasa loa Mungu loonga mbo— Ailomoko Inde likolo, Inde lokɛsɛnɛ la limbilititi lia ebaindomoko lande, limɔ akaelaka bato bakaɔ.
english: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.” Psalms 68:18

lokele: ¿Baoi-ba bende to la lini litina; Ailomoko, liti to mbo atasulwäkä oso ko ono se nda nyɛlɛ?
english: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

lokele: Oyasulwaka se ale ngo ko Inde oyailomoko olikolo lia Use bototina mbo atumeseke yaatotina,
english: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

lokele: la bakaɔ ebafak’Inde, bako mbo, bamɔi Batomomu, bamɔi Batɔndɔli, bamɔi banangoli ba Mboli Ilau, bamɔi betingani ya liyasa lia Yesu, bamɔi baekesi,
english: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds 4:11 and teachers;

lokele: mbo bakomiomoko ndokelaka likuwa lia basungi ba ebüchomu, ndokokɔmɛsɛ Etanda eko bindo ya Masiya,
english: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

lokele: konda akiyelek’iso yaatotina kwa ɔmwito nda lilendelu la liluwani lia Wana wa Mungu, konda akakondek’iso botolome oku yoengana l’ikweelo sha boyaeli wa Inde oyasɔɔlwa ako Masiya.
english: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

lokele: Mbo totayala imɔ kwa bana’oli bofalimana la boeyaeyaesomoko la fofo bitotina ya liekesi lia bato ba bolimbakeli, ko la shɔngɔlɔ sha iɔlɛ shau sholimbaka basi.
english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

lokele: Kongo ko atoongan’iso ko momongo la losamɔ, tokondeleke ngo ko ende Masiya nda njasɔ bitotina, Inde ale boto angɛnɛ,
english: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,

lokele: la eoka ya Botö-yo bindo bitotina ani bisoonjakelakana la bisowatemana ko l’eoka ya baonge batotina ebatomu nde la bofoka woengana likuwa lia elengö la elengö ebitofumbesa likondi lia bindo, ndokɔkɔmɛlɛ la losamɔ.
english: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

lokele: Eokao isoonga lanu liasi la isokambes’ino nda lina lia Ngɛnɛ wasu, mbo otayal’imɔ kwa akoyali eba tukela ya wenda, la liyaëlä nda betema yau;
english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

lokele: basotufatufa nda baenyeli, basosiama sia la loiko loa Mungu eoka ya botutuku ebole nda betema yau eoka bisokwa bowäü finɛ.
english: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.

lokele: Baitok’imɔ la basotaka betema yau se nda bolëfë la basolola bekeeli bitotina ya bɔwɛwɛ.
english: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

lokele: Nde ino otieke njasɔ ya Masiya ongoma;
english: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

lokele: ambo woki nde mboli yande la mbo wekesomu nde wewe wa njasɔ ebisoomana lande ako Yesu.
english: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

lokele: Sokolaka to boyaeli wanu wa oso kwa atosokolomo esinda eyesoya ɛkwɛlɛ, boyaeli ebosɔɔlɔ eoka ya yɛmɛ ya bolimbake,
english: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

lokele: la kindolomoko nde boyaeli boyai wa bolimo wa betema yanu;
english: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

lokele: wataka boyaeli wa boto boyai oyasotonjomo la liluku lia Mungu la liengani la botanu wa wewe.
english: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

lokele: Eokao, machaka bolimbake bototina fɛɛ, onganaka ko la wewe, eoka oto la oto ale ngo ko elengo ya bindo ɛmwito.
english: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

lokele: Bosoma nde, okelëke litwanelo nda lisomi liaɛ; likɔlɔse litaosh’ino oko la lisomi lianu,
english: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Psalms 4:4 Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

lokele: la ofëke Satana fofe nda betema yanu.
english: and don’t give place 4:27 to the devil.

lokele: Ewa wiya, wiyëk’mo, kangä akelaka likuwa liwau la besamba yande angɛnɛ, mbo ayaleke la yeka yofaefaka eba boeno.
english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

lokele: Okusolëke lioi ango limɔi lia bɔwɛwɛ nda bɛnɔkɔ yanu, kangä lioi lilau lioengana fofe mbo liokeseke ebatoka liao ko bootaota.
english: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

lokele: Wokesëke Bolimo Botanu wa Mungu botema wale, watomoko nde ndembe ya chapa ya Bolimo-ao loasɔ loa lise lia liendolomu lianu.
english: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

lokele: Bokëlë la bolengi la efango la bosho la limɔli, bitotina-bi bisokolomo end’ino la lisiela lisanga.
english: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

lokele: Nde yalakanaka la booto, la ngandi, la limɛsɛlɛni kwa amɛsɛlɛkɛ Mungu omɛsɛl’ino ani awatemani ino la Masiya.
english: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

lokele: Eokao, kwekelaka Mungu ani atokelak’Inde kwa bana bande ebasamomu.
english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

lokele: Kɛndɛkɛndɛkɛ la boyaeli wa losamɔ, kwa Masiya asamak’imo ko iso la afaefaka liwawi liande angɛnɛ eoka yasu, lifaefi la litambi ende Mungu, eliaka la liɛsɛ lilau. Beimo loasɔ loa yɛmɛ ya bindo
english: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

lokele: Nde njasɔ-bi biko bolëfë la bɔwɛwɛ bototina ango bolole, bitiengnae ango ndosingwomo lanu ebüchomu la Masiya;
english: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

lokele: la boendu la baoi ba sɔni la këka imɔ ebitiengane lanu, kangä liineli lia kelekele.
english: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

lokele: Luwaka to la wɛlï mbo, boto wa bolëfë, wa bɔwɛwɛ, kwa ewa bolole, oyale kwa bosemoli wa bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu, ati ango la botiko nda Bɔkɔta wa Masiya la ewa Mungu.
english: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

lokele: Boto angɔmɔi ataimbak’ino la baoi ebati la litina, eoka efango ya Mungu esoyela bana ba totefola ko loasɔ loa e-njasɔ-bi.
english: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

lokele: Eokao oyalanëke lau basaɔ;
english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

lokele: wayalaka nde oso ko lilima, kongo ko kwani wende löwa ani awatemani ino la Ngɛnɛ. Kɛndɛnɛkɛ to la boyaeli wa bana ba löwa,
english: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

lokele: Eoka tuma etosokonda nda löwa tole njasɔ bitotina ebile bilau, ebile la liengani, ebile wewe.
english: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

lokele: Kotaka ndoluwa ko njasɔ ebitoomalesa Ngɛnɛ,
english: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

lokele: okɛsɛnɛ̈kɛ la bekeeli ya lilima ebitiɔlɛs’ino bolau, kanga kotombola yao.
english: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

lokele: Eoka sɔni finɛ ango ndoongana njasɔ ebitokel’iyo la wisakumbo.
english: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

lokele: Nde asoisolomo bitotina-bi ko la löwa, limɔ bisoɛnɛlɛ fololo, eoka bitotina ebisoɛnɛlɛ fololo bile lowa.
english: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

lokele: Eokao, kwa asoonga bɔɛlɛ mbo— Siswa, aɛ oyaingali, Kuswaka nda liwa, oyasowa; Limɔ Masiya nd’atoanes’aɛ kwa löwa!
english: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

lokele: Tichakaka to la wɛlï ani atokɛnd’ino, inga kwa bibebe, kangä kwa eba wɛlï;
english: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

lokele: wetesëke fofe ya liuwesi eoka mbile-ye bile ibe.
english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

lokele: Eokao oyalëke bato ebatienyele njasɔ la wɛlï, kangä koluwa kwa ayali lisangi lia Ngɛnɛ.
english: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

lokele: Owëke bänä, eoka bao bende la libebesi, nde tumesomoko la Bolimo.
english: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

lokele: Twelanaka bɛɛlɛ la ngambi la yulwelo ya Bolimo, mbo lielo la tongolole twa bɛɛlɛ ya betema yanu biiyeke ko ende Ngɛnɛ wasu,
english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

lokele: la kelekele mbile la mbile eoka ya yeka bitotina ende Mungu Sango, ko la lina lia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya. Boimo wa lilitesani lia bali la batolome
english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

lokele: Litesanaka eoka ya liwangi liowanga Masiya.
english: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

lokele: Ino bali, litesaka balome banu angɛnɛ kwa atolitesomo Ngɛnɛ,
english: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

lokele: eoka bolome ende botö wa wali wande, kwa ayali Masiya imɔ Boto wa Etanda la Bouwesi wa bindo eko Etanda.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

lokele: Kwa ani atolitesa Etanda olitesa Masiya, ko ongoma bali baliteseke balome bau nda njasɔ bitotina.
english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

lokele: Ino batolome, samaka bali banu kwa asamaka Masiya osama Etanda la afaka liwawi liande eoka ya Etanda,
english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

lokele: mbo ücheke yao ko la litanesi lia lilufi ïia bali la lioi lia tele,
english: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

lokele: la mbo atambeke Etanda kwa wali, la tala l’angwɛnɛ liälö, l’angwɛnɛ basushɛlɛ, l’angwɛnɛ loasɔ loasi lobe, sakolo ngo ko mbo ayaleke wüchomu la angwɛnɛ litwanelo.
english: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

lokele: Ongoma loengani mbo batolome basameke bali bau kwa bindo yau angɛnɛ. Oyasosama wali wande, asosama imɔ ko inde angɛnɛ.
english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

lokele: Boto aitoiyela bindo yande angɛnɛ, nde atoongola yao la atotɛmya yao, kwa atokelaka Masiya loasɔ loa Etanda,
english: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

lokele: eoka tole bilengo ya Bindo yande.
english: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

lokele: Eoka ya litina-li, boto atomacha sango la nyango wande la atowatema la wali wande limɔ iyo yaambale batoyala ko bindo ɛmwito.
english: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.” Genesis 2:24

lokele: Loasɔ-lo eloisameli litina, lole lofi; nde imi nd’atangi mbo lole loa Etanda la eloa Masiya;
english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

lokele: kongo ko ino imɔ, oto la oto, asameke wali wande kwa inde angɛnɛ, la wali mbo aliteseke bolome wande.
english: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

lokele: Ino bana, litesaka ebaot’ino, eoka engani nde ndokela ongoma ende ebawatemi la Ngɛnɛ.
english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

lokele: Litesaka sango waɛ la nyango waɛ, yao ende ekela ya oso eyele la lisakä,
english: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

lokele: mbo oyaleke la bolau la mbo umweke yumwa ono se.
english: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.” Deuteronomy 5:16

lokele: Nde ino basango, osomesëke bana banu, kongo ko kɔsɔlɔk’iyo kwa atoekekesomo bana la likomyi la liekesi lia Ngɛnɛ wasu. Boimo ende Bɛkɔwa la Bangɛnɛ bau
english: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

lokele: Ino bɛkɔwa, litesaka bangɛnɛ banu ebale bato la bɔwa la liilimi la botema wa momongo kwa mbo otolitesa Masiya;
english: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

lokele: inga to kwa toambacha ko l’eoka basotichak’ino, kangä kwa bɛkɔwa ya Masiya ebatokelaka lisangi lia Mungu la botema bototina;
english: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

lokele: la lisangi lilau kwa mbo lile likuwa lia Ngɛnɛ wasu, inga elia bato kongo,
english: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

lokele: osoluwa to mbo boto la boto oyasokela likuwa la olau, Ngɛnɛ koinoel’inde imɔ ko olau, kwa ende bɔkɔwa kwa iote.
english: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

lokele: Ino bangɛnɛ kelaka imɔ ko ongoma end’iyo, la machaka ndowaekes’iyo eoka osoluwa mbo Ngɛnɛ wau la ewanu imɔ ale nda Use, la mbo aitokwelakwela biombo ya bato. Biɛla ya bewangɔ ya Masiya
english: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

lokele: Lioi lia tuu, mbo— Wangemaka ko la liwatemi amamwito la Ngɛnɛ wasu la bofoka wa isosha shande.
english: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

lokele: Wataka biɛla bitotina ya Mungu mbo okɔkɔlɛkɛ ndokɔkɔmɔ ani otonana la fuko ya tɔɔlɛ twa Satana.
english: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

lokele: Eoka nda bita-bi, toitonana la binyo la bakila, kangä la bekumi la tososha la bakakalesi ba wenda wa botutuku la ngendi ya belimo ibe ya use.
english: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

lokele: Eokao, undaka to biɛla bitotina ya Mungu mbo okɔkɔlɛkɛ ndokɔkɔmɛlɛ nda lise libe, la ani osonana la bofoka bototina, ko ndokɔkɔmɔ.
english: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

lokele: Kɔkɔmɔkɔ to kɔkɛ! Wataka bɔkɔli nda tɛta yanu la momongo, la libala lia liengani nda bokükü,
english: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

lokele: la tokwaka nda batindi, toko liendesi lia Mboli Ilau ya lilatemi;
english: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

lokele: undaka bitotina-bi, simbi to nguwa ya lilendelu, ko la yao bokɔkɔlɔkɔ ndotungelesa kɔkɔ ya bösä bitotina ya Ewa Bobe.
english: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

lokele: Aelaka imɔ kɔmɔ ya yeto eko liuwesi, la chaka eyefomu la Bolimo, eko Lioi lia Mungu.
english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word 6:17 of God;

lokele: Sombokolaka mbile bitotina la basomboli la baömbi batotina ko la Bolimo, eokao yalaka la botengu wosombokola la bofiili loasɔ loa ebüchomu batotina ba Masiya.
english: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.

lokele: Sombokolaka imɔ loasɔ loami mbo lioi lioengana lifomoko’mi ani akalioleke’mi bɔnɔkɔ wami inangokoleke la lotendela njasɔ ebisoisolomo ya Mboli Ilau;
english: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

lokele: eoka ya Mboli Ilau imi nd’ale wɛndi la ikomya oyakandomu bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, sombokolaka to mbo iteke boeki wa yao la lotendela, ani engani lami ndoke a.
english: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

lokele: Mbo ino oluweke kwa ayalli’mi la ani atokela’mi, ongoma to Tukiko etungani oyasamomu lasu la bosungi wa lotimbana nda likuwa lia Ngɛnɛ, inde nd’atoluwes’ino njasɔ bitotina.
english: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.

lokele: Isotoma inde end’ino ko l’a litina-li, mbo oluweke ani ayali njasɔ yasu la mbo afumbeseke betema yanu. Lisomboli lia lifotesi liotungesa lokasa
english: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.

lokele: Lilatemi la losamɔ, amamwito la lilendelu, ya Mungu Sango la Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya, bifomoko ende bitungani yasu ya Etanda.
english: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Booto boyaleke la batotina ebatosamaka Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya la losamɔ elotilasaek’imɔ.
english: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
